newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB buys US executive relocation business.
newsitem.headline: NAB buys US executive relocation business.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to buy the assets of an executive relocation business based in St Louis, Missouri, in the U.S. for an undisclosed sum.
NAB said Boatmen's Relocation Management, with US$31 million receivables, had a 31 year history and long-standing customer relationships.
The business would be integrated with a similar sized executive relocation busines owned by NAB's wholly owned Michigan National Bank.
NAB said the small acquisiton would be a strong strategic fit with NAB's existing relocation business.
"This is a consolidation opportunity which will cement our market position, taking us to number four on a national basis," NAB's group general manager U.S. and Asia, Bob Prowse, said in a statement.
"Executive relocation services complement the provision of broader financial services and contribute to non-interest revenue," he said.
The transaction was expected to close in the June quarter.
